posted_text:
💰 MI SB 0980 — Michigan Could Ban Crypto Kiosks

Michigan is considering a law to stop businesses from setting up machines that let you buy or sell cryptocurrency with regular money.

The bill defines what a ‘cryptocurrency kiosk’ is – essentially any electronic terminal that handles crypto transactions – and makes it illegal to install or operate one.

Violators could face civil fines ranging from $2,000 to $10,000 depending on whether it’s a first or repeated offense.

Oct. 27, 2026: Reported Favorably Without Amendment 10/14/2026.
